name: atec 404 Tracker
author: docjojo

sections.description:
Log and count 404 page requests to identify broken links, mistyped URLs, and bot scans. Clean and lightweight — ideal for diagnostics and redirect planning.

Features

Attempts will be logged as transients, with auto-clean-up after the timeout.
There is no extra database table required.

Third-Party Services

Integrity check

Once, when activating the plugin, an integrity check is requested from our server – if you give your permission.
Source: https://atecplugins.com/
Privacy policy: https://atecplugins.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WP admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
  3. Select “atec 404 Tracker” link in admin menu bar.
  4. No configuration required.
